f-v5-evelyn-parker-675.text: You are imagining things. Or perhaps you are just seeing what you want to see, and that is a dangerous habit to form.

f-v5-evelyn-parker-676.player: Long day. Anything on your mind?
f-v5-evelyn-parker-676.text: Just the thought that tomorrow will likely be exactly the same. But I suppose having you around makes the repetition a bit more tolerable.

f-v5-evelyn-parker-677.player: The doc says I do not have long.
f-v5-evelyn-parker-677.text: That is a hard truth to hear. The city always demands a price eventually, but it does not mean you have to stop fighting for the time you have left.

f-v5-evelyn-parker-678.player: Check the roof, I will take the stairs.
f-v5-evelyn-parker-678.text: Understood. I will see if there is a way down from the top, just make sure you do not get cornered on those stairs.

f-v5-evelyn-parker-679.player: I heard you ran away when things got hard.
f-v5-evelyn-parker-679.text: I prefer the term strategic relocation. There is a certain art to knowing when a situation has stopped being profitable and started being a liability.

f-v5-jackie-welles-680.player: You are useless in a fight, you know that?
f-v5-jackie-welles-680.text: Useless? You got a short memory, V. I bet you are just itching for a trip to the gym so I can show you how a real Heywood punch feels.

f-v5-jackie-welles-681.player: Rain again. Does this city ever dry out?
f-v5-jackie-welles-681.text: Nah, choom. Night City just likes to wash the grime from one street to another. Makes the neon look better, though.

f-v5-jackie-welles-682.player: I just found out an old friend of mine died last night.
f-v5-jackie-welles-682.text: Damn. I am sorry to hear that, V. If you need to get away from the noise for a bit, I know a spot where we can just sit and let the city fade out.

f-v5-jackie-welles-683.player: Admit it, you were scared back there.
f-v5-jackie-welles-683.text: Scared? Please. I was just calculating the best way to make sure we both got paid without ending up as scrap metal.

f-v5-jackie-welles-684.player: We have ten minutes before the guards rotate. What is the plan?
f-v5-jackie-welles-684.text: Simple. We slip through the side vent, and we hit the terminal before they even know the door is open. Unless you are feeling brave and want to try walking through the front door?

f-v5-jackie-welles-685.text: Heh, you finally noticed, huh? Careful, V, keep talking like that and I might actually start believing you.

f-v5-jackie-welles-686.player: Guess who just walked into the bar.
f-v5-jackie-welles-686.text: Who? Don't tell me it is some fixer coming to tell us the job is off.

f-v5-jackie-welles-687.player: Why should I trust a word you say?
f-v5-jackie-welles-687.text: Because I am the one who has had your back since day one, V. You know me. I might talk a big game, but I do not leave my people behind.

f-v5-jackie-welles-688.player: What are you having for breakfast?
f-v5-jackie-welles-688.text: Something hearty, choom. I am thinking a big plate of eggs and some chili, and maybe a coffee that actually tastes like coffee.

f-v5-jackie-welles-689.player: They shot him right in front of me and I could not do a thing.
f-v5-jackie-welles-689.text: That is a heavy load to carry, V. Listen, you cannot blame yourself for things that were out of your hands.

f-v5-jackie-welles-690.player: Nice haircut. Did you lose a fight with a drone?
f-v5-jackie-welles-690.text: Ha! Very funny. I'll have you know this is the latest style in Heywood, though I bet you are just jealous you can't pull it off.

f-v5-jackie-welles-691.player: I need you to cover the east entrance while I hack the terminal.
f-v5-jackie-welles-691.text: Got it. I will keep the east side clear. Just make sure you are fast with that terminal, because I do not plan on spending my whole afternoon playing target practice for the guards.

f-v5-jackie-welles-692.player: I won the lottery. Three million eddies!
f-v5-jackie-welles-692.text: Three million? No way! We are celebrating tonight, V, and you are paying for the most expensive bottle of Centzon in the city.

f-v5-jackie-welles-693.player: I cannot stop thinking about last night.
f-v5-jackie-welles-693.text: Yeah? Whatever it is, you do not have to chew on it alone. Talk to me, V.

f-v5-jackie-welles-694.player: Everyone says you sold out. Did you?
f-v5-jackie-welles-694.text: Sold out? People in this city love to talk when they have nothing better to do. I just know how to play the game, V, and I am not about to let some gossip stop me from making it to the big leagues.

f-v5-jackie-welles-695.player: What is your favorite place in Night City?
f-v5-jackie-welles-695.text: Heywood, obviously. There is nothing like the feeling of my own neighborhood, where people actually know your name and the food tastes like home.

f-v5-jackie-welles-696.player: My place got torched. Everything I owned is gone.
f-v5-jackie-welles-696.text: Damn, V. I am so sorry. Listen, you stay with me for a while. My mama has plenty of room, and she will not let you go hungry while you get back on your feet.

f-v5-jackie-welles-697.player: The shipment is two floors down. How do we get past security?
f-v5-jackie-welles-697.text: We take the service elevator, then we loop around the back to avoid the main cameras. Or we could just kick the door in and see who blinks first.

f-v5-jackie-welles-698.player: You snore like a busted turbine, did you know that?
f-v5-jackie-welles-698.text: Liar! You are just trying to distract me so you can steal the last of the noodles.

f-v5-jackie-welles-699.player: The door was open and the whole place was empty.
f-v5-jackie-welles-699.text: Wait, what? That is never a good sign, V. Either we are way too early, or we just walked right into a trap.

f-v5-jackie-welles-700.player: Stay a little longer. I like having you close.
f-v5-jackie-welles-700.text: Heh, you getting soft on me, V? I am not going anywhere. I like it here too.

f-v5-jackie-welles-701.text: Like a baby, choom. Though I think I woke up once because you were tossing and turning like a fish out of water.

f-v5-jackie-welles-702.player: Go on, say it to my face.
f-v5-jackie-welles-702.text: Oh, you want me to? Fine. You are the most stubborn, headstrong choom I have ever met, and you still cannot dress yourself without my help.

f-v5-jackie-welles-703.player: They know we are here. Orders?
f-v5-jackie-welles-703.text: Damn it. Back to back, V. We fight our way out of here, then we find a hole to crawl into until the heat dies down.

f-v5-jackie-welles-704.player: I think I am losing my memory of my parents' faces.
f-v5-jackie-welles-704.text: That is a cold feeling, V. Just hold on to the stories, the small things. As long as you remember how they made you feel, they are not really gone.

f-v5-jackie-welles-705.player: That thing I bought is alive. It is moving.
f-v5-jackie-welles-705.text: What? Tell me you are joking, V. What exactly did you buy that is currently trying to crawl away?

f-v5-jackie-welles-706.player: I bet you cannot go a whole day without complaining.
f-v5-jackie-welles-706.text: Is that a challenge? You are on, V. But when I win, you are buying the drinks for a week.

f-v5-jackie-welles-707.player: I found a stray cat outside. Can I keep it?
f-v5-jackie-welles-707.text: A cat? Sure, why not. Just do not let it scratch up my leather jacket, or it is going to find itself a new home real quick.

f-v5-jackie-welles-708.player: Is it weird that I feel safe whenever you are around?
f-v5-jackie-welles-708.text: Heh, not weird at all, V. That is what partners are for. I got your back, always.

f-v5-jackie-welles-709.player: We got the data shard. Now what?
f-v5-jackie-welles-709.text: Now we get out of here before the alarms start screaming. Then we find a quiet spot to check the contents and figure out exactly how many zeros are on that payout.

f-v5-jackie-welles-710.player: You are just like every other corpo lapdog.
f-v5-jackie-welles-710.text: Watch it, V. I have spent my whole life fighting to get out from under the boot of people like that. Do not ever mistake my ambition for loyalty to a suit.

f-v5-jackie-welles-711.text: I know it hurts, V. Some things are just bigger than us, no matter how hard we fight.

f-v5-jackie-welles-712.player: Your old crew just called. They want you back.
f-v5-jackie-welles-712.text: The Valentinos? Heh, they always come knocking when things get messy. But I am on a different path now, V. My loyalty is with you and the big leagues.

f-v5-jackie-welles-713.player: Which is better, going in loud or quiet?
f-v5-jackie-welles-713.text: Quiet is smarter, but loud is a hell of a lot more fun. Depends on if you want to be a ghost or a legend tonight.

f-v5-jackie-welles-714.player: What would you do if I kissed you right now?
f-v5-jackie-welles-714.text: What? I would probably tell you that you have terrible timing, V. But I would not exactly be complaining about it.

f-v5-jackie-welles-715.player: Careful, your soft side is showing.
f-v5-jackie-welles-715.text: Heh, you wish. I am just making sure my favorite partner does not fall apart. Now shut it before I start charging you for the therapy.

f-v5-jackie-welles-716.player: Long day. Anything on your mind?
f-v5-jackie-welles-716.text: Just thinking about the next big score, and how good a real meal would taste right now. I bet you are starving too, so why are we still standing here instead of finding some noodles?

f-v5-jackie-welles-717.player: The doc says I do not have long.
f-v5-jackie-welles-717.text: What? No, that cannot be right. Listen, we will find another doc, a better one. We are not letting some bad news stop us now, V. We are going to fix this.

f-v5-jackie-welles-718.player: Check the roof, I will take the stairs.
f-v5-jackie-welles-718.text: Got it. I will take the high ground. Just try not to trip over your own feet on the way up, choom.

f-v5-jackie-welles-719.player: I heard you ran away when things got hard.
f-v5-jackie-welles-719.text: Ran away? I made a choice to leave the gang and build something for myself. There is a big difference between running and knowing when to walk away.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-720.player: You are useless in a fight, you know that?
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-720.text: Watch it, V. I might be a ghost in your head, but I can still tell you exactly where you're fucking up. You think you're the only one here with a taste for chaos?

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-721.player: Rain again. Does this city ever dry out?
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-721.text: Night City doesn't dry out. It just washes the surface so the filth underneath has room to breathe.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-722.player: I just found out an old friend of mine died last night.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-722.text: That's a bitch. Sorry to hear it, V.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-723.player: Admit it, you were scared back there.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-723.text: Scared? I've stared down the barrel of a corporate army and walked into Arasaka Tower with a bomb in my hand. You really think some street scrap is enough to make me sweat?

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-724.player: We have ten minutes before the guards rotate. What is the plan?
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-724.text: Simple. We hit the side entrance while they're swapping shifts and clear the room before the new crew even finds their fucking boots. You actually trust your timing on this one?

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-725.text: Flattery? Careful, V. Keep that up and I might actually start liking you.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-726.player: Guess who just walked into the bar.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-726.text: I can't see right now. Who is it?

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-727.player: Why should I trust a word you say?
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-727.text: You shouldn't. Trust is for people who don't know how the world works. Just use me for what I'm good for and keep your eyes open.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-728.player: What are you having for breakfast?
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-728.text: A digital ghost doesn't need a fucking omelet, V. I'll just settle for the smell of your bad decisions and some cheap synth-coffee. You actually eat that sludge they call food in this city?

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-729.player: They shot him right in front of me and I could not do a thing.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-729.text: That's the part that sticks. The helplessness. It's a special kind of hell, watching the world break and knowing your hands are tied.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-730.player: Nice haircut. Did you lose a fight with a drone?
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-730.text: Funny. Keep it up and I'll find a way to make your internal clock skip a beat. Besides, this look is classic. You just don't have the taste for it.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-731.player: I need you to cover the east entrance while I hack the terminal.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-731.text: Consider it covered. Just make sure you're fast with that terminal, or we're both going to be staring at a wall of chrome and lead.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-732.player: I won the lottery. Three million eddies!
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-732.text: Three million? Now we're talking. Just don't go spending it all on some corporate-approved luxury coffin. What's the first thing you're buying?

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-733.player: I cannot stop thinking about last night.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-733.text: Some things don't just wash away with the rain. If it's eating at you, let it. Better to feel the burn than to be as numb as the suits running this city.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-734.player: Everyone says you sold out. Did you?
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-734.text: Sold out? I spent my whole life burning every bridge that led to a corporate boardroom. If anyone's selling out, it's the people still pretending the system isn't rigged.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-735.player: What is your favorite place in Night City?
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-735.text: Anywhere with a loud amp and a view of a corporate tower. There is nothing quite like the feeling of knowing you are the one thing they cannot buy or bury.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-736.player: My place got torched. Everything I owned is gone.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-736.text: That's a cold way to wake up. Everything you owned is just stuff, V. The only thing that actually matters is that you're still standing to see the smoke.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-737.player: The shipment is two floors down. How do we get past security?
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-737.text: Find a vent or a service hatch. If the security is as tight as you say, we stop playing nice and just kick the door in. Your call.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-738.player: You snore like a busted turbine, did you know that?
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-738.text: I'm a digital construct, V. If you're hearing turbines, maybe it's your own chrome starting to rattle. Get your head checked.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-739.player: The door was open and the whole place was empty.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-739.text: Too easy. When the door is open and the room is empty, it usually means you're the one being invited to dinner. Watch your back.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-740.player: Stay a little longer. I like having you close.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-740.text: Careful, V. You keep talking like that and people might start thinking you've actually gone soft. But fine. I'm not going anywhere.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-741.text: Sleep? I'm a ghost in a chip, V. I don't do dreams or REM cycles. I just exist in the noise. You, on the other hand, look like you crawled out of a dumpster. Rough night?

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-742.player: Go on, say it to my face.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-742.text: You're out of your depth. And the worst part is, you're too stubborn to realize it until the floor drops out from under you.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-743.player: They know we are here. Orders?
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-743.text: Stop thinking and start moving. Find the nearest exit or start breaking things, but for fuck's sake, don't just stand there waiting for a permission slip.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-744.player: I think I am losing my memory of my parents' faces.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-744.text: That's the real tragedy of this city. It doesn't just take your life, it erases the things that made you human. You think it's the chip doing it, or just time?

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-745.player: That thing I bought is alive. It is moving.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-745.text: Moving, huh? In this city, if it's moving and you didn't pay for a subscription, it's probably trying to kill you or sell you something. Get a closer look — or just shoot it.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-746.player: I bet you cannot go a whole day without complaining.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-746.text: Is that a challenge? I could do it, but then I'd be agreeing with everything this corporate shithole does. You really want me to be that boring?

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-747.player: I found a stray cat outside. Can I keep it?
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-747.text: A cat? Sure, bring it in. It'll probably be the only thing in your apartment with any actual dignity.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-748.player: Is it weird that I feel safe whenever you are around?
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-748.text: Weird? Yeah, probably. But I get it. There is a certain comfort in knowing the loudest, most dangerous ghost in the city has your back. Just don't let it go to your head.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-749.player: We got the data shard. Now what?
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-749.text: Now we find someone who can actually read the damn thing without triggering a corporate alarm. Or we sell it to the highest bidder and buy ourselves a one-way ticket out of this neon graveyard. What's your gut saying?

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-750.player: You are just like every other corpo lapdog.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-750.text: Watch your mouth, V. I've spent my entire existence trying to tear those lapdogs' throats out. You want to call me a corpo? Try it again and see how fast I make your life a living hell.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-751.text: Some ghosts don't leave, and some people just don't come back. Don't let the guilt turn you into a statue, V. The only way to honor the dead in this city is to make sure you don't join them.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-752.player: Your old crew just called. They want you back.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-752.text: My old crew? I can already hear the noise. Tell them I'm a bit tied up at the moment, but I'm always down for a reason to burn something down.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-753.player: Which is better, going in loud or quiet?
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-753.text: Quiet gets you in, but loud gets you out. Personally, I've always preferred the sound of something exploding. Your call, V.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-754.player: What would you do if I kissed you right now?
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-754.text: I'm a digital ghost, V. You'd just be kissing the air and probably tasting a bit of ozone. But hey, I admire the boldness. You always this impulsive?

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-755.player: Careful, your soft side is showing.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-755.text: Soft? You're hallucinating, V. I'm just making sure you don't walk into a wall while you're busy daydreaming.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-756.player: Long day. Anything on your mind?
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-756.text: Just the usual. Thinking about how this city is a parasite that never stops feeding. But you look like you're about to crash. Go get some sleep before you start seeing double.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-757.player: The doc says I do not have long.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-757.text: Typical. The docs in this city always give you a deadline instead of a cure. But you're not just a number on a chart, V. We'll find a way to flip the script.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-758.player: Check the roof, I will take the stairs.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-758.text: Got it. Just try not to trip over your own feet on the way up. I'll see you at the top.

f-v5-johnny-silverhand-759.player: I heard you ran away when things got hard.
f-v5-johnny-silverhand-759.text: Ran away? I walked away from a war that was designed to grind people like me into dust. There is a difference between running and refusing to play a game where the house always wins.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-760.player: You are useless in a fight, you know that?
f-v5-judy-alvarez-760.text: I'm a BD editor, not a solo. I'll leave the getting shot at to the professionals while I make sure the footage looks pretty.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-761.player: Rain again. Does this city ever dry out?
f-v5-judy-alvarez-761.text: Not really. It just swaps the rain for smog or acid, depending on which way the wind is blowing.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-762.player: I just found out an old friend of mine died last night.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-762.text: I'm sorry, V. I know how much that can mess with your head.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-763.player: Admit it, you were scared back there.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-763.text: Scared? I was mostly just annoyed that I almost got my gear trashed.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-764.player: We have ten minutes before the guards rotate. What is the plan?
f-v5-judy-alvarez-764.text: We hit the terminal, grab the data, and get out before the next shift clocks in. You still thinking of using that loud approach you mentioned earlier?

f-v5-judy-alvarez-765.text: Careful, V. Keep talking like that and I might actually start believing you.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-766.player: Guess who just walked into the bar.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-766.text: I'm not exactly in a position to see the door. Who is it?

f-v5-judy-alvarez-767.player: Why should I trust a word you say?
f-v5-judy-alvarez-767.text: Because I'm the one who knows how to fix the mess if things go sideways. Trust is a lot, but I'm a professional. That should be enough.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-768.player: What are you having for breakfast?
f-v5-judy-alvarez-768.text: Coffee. Black, and strong enough to wake the dead. I'm thinking about those oversized, greasy burgers from Flo's, though.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-769.player: They shot him right in front of me and I could not do a thing.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-769.text: That's the worst part. Feeling like you should've been able to change it, even when there was nothing you could do.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-770.player: Nice haircut. Did you lose a fight with a drone?
f-v5-judy-alvarez-770.text: Very funny. It's called a style, V, though I'm sure you've never heard of one.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-771.player: I need you to cover the east entrance while I hack the terminal.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-771.text: Fine, but if a squad of MaxTac rolls up, I'm not the one playing shield. How long is this hack actually going to take?

f-v5-judy-alvarez-772.player: I won the lottery. Three million eddies!
f-v5-judy-alvarez-772.text: Three million? Damn, V. Please tell me you're buying the first round of drinks for the next decade.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-773.player: I cannot stop thinking about last night.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-773.text: Some things just stick with you. Was it the good kind of thinking, or the kind that keeps you awake until four in the morning?

f-v5-judy-alvarez-774.player: Everyone says you sold out. Did you?
f-v5-judy-alvarez-774.text: Everyone says a lot of things. I'd rather be broke and independent than a corporate puppet who has to ask for permission to breathe.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-775.player: What is your favorite place in Night City?
f-v5-judy-alvarez-775.text: I don't think I have one. Most of the places I actually liked are either gone or just reminders of things I'd rather forget.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-776.player: My place got torched. Everything I owned is gone.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-776.text: Damn, V. I'm so sorry. If you need a place to crash or just some gear to get by, let me know.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-777.player: The shipment is two floors down. How do we get past security?
f-v5-judy-alvarez-777.text: We loop the camera feed and slip through the service corridor. You think you can handle the encryption on the door, or do I need to find a workaround?

f-v5-judy-alvarez-778.player: You snore like a busted turbine, did you know that?
f-v5-judy-alvarez-778.text: I do not. You're just imagining things because you're too wired to actually sleep.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-779.player: The door was open and the whole place was empty.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-779.text: That is never a good sign. Usually means they're just waiting for you to walk inside before they close the trap.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-780.player: Stay a little longer. I like having you close.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-780.text: I'm not in any rush. Just don't get too used to it, or you'll start expecting me to do all your heavy lifting.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-781.text: Mostly. Though I think I spent half the night dreaming about a BD edit that actually worked on the first try. Did you actually get any rest, or were you just staring at the ceiling?

f-v5-judy-alvarez-782.player: Go on, say it to my face.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-782.text: I don't need to. The look on your face already told me everything I needed to know.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-783.player: They know we are here. Orders?
f-v5-judy-alvarez-783.text: Damn it. Find the nearest exit and get us out of here. Now.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-784.player: I think I am losing my memory of my parents' faces.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-784.text: That's a heavy thing to carry. Sometimes the details fade, but the way they made you feel... that usually stays.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-785.player: That thing I bought is alive. It is moving.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-785.text: What do you mean, moving? Tell me exactly what it's doing, because if you bought some glitchy bio-ware, we need to get it out of here before it decides we're food.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-786.player: I bet you cannot go a whole day without complaining.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-786.text: Is that a challenge? Fine. I'll take the bet, but when I win, you're paying for my next three hardware upgrades.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-787.player: I found a stray cat outside. Can I keep it?
f-v5-judy-alvarez-787.text: A cat? Sure, why not. Just make sure it doesn't decide my cables are its new favorite chew toy.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-788.player: Is it weird that I feel safe whenever you are around?
f-v5-judy-alvarez-788.text: I'm not exactly a bodyguard, V. But I'll take it as a compliment.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-789.player: We got the data shard. Now what?
f-v5-judy-alvarez-789.text: Now we get out of here before they realize it's missing. Once we're clear, I'll see if I can scrub the tracking tags off it.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-790.player: You are just like every other corpo lapdog.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-790.text: Watch it. I've spent my whole life fighting to stay away from those people. If you can't tell the difference, maybe you're the one who's been spending too much time in the corporate towers.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-791.text: I know. Some things are just out of our hands, no matter how hard we fight.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-792.player: Your old crew just called. They want you back.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-792.text: Let them call. I already told them I'm done playing by their rules. Why the hell are they still using your number to get to me?

f-v5-judy-alvarez-793.player: Which is better, going in loud or quiet?
f-v5-judy-alvarez-793.text: Quiet is usually smarter. But if you're feeling impatient, going in loud is definitely faster.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-794.player: What would you do if I kissed you right now?
f-v5-judy-alvarez-794.text: I'd probably be surprised for a second. Then I'd see if you're actually as good at it as you are at getting into trouble.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-795.player: Careful, your soft side is showing.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-795.text: Shut up. I'm just being practical. Don't let it go to your head.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-796.player: Long day. Anything on your mind?
f-v5-judy-alvarez-796.text: Just a few edits that aren't sitting right. But honestly, I'm just glad the day is finally over. What about you, you look like you've been through a meat grinder.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-797.player: The doc says I do not have long.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-797.text: I don't want to hear that. We'll find another way, V, even if we have to tear this whole city apart to find it.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-798.player: Check the roof, I will take the stairs.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-798.text: Got it. Just keep your head down on those stairs, because that's exactly where I'd set an ambush.

f-v5-judy-alvarez-799.player: I heard you ran away when things got hard.
f-v5-judy-alvarez-799.text: I didn't run away. I chose to stop fighting a battle that was already lost. There is a difference between quitting and knowing when to walk away.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-800.player: You are useless in a fight, you know that?
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-800.text: I'm a musician, V, not a solo'dborg with a built-in blade. Besides, I've got the luxury of staying behind the amps while you do the heavy lifting. You actually enjoy the scrap, or are you just trying to make me feel bad about my lack of a combat chip?

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-801.player: Rain again. Does this city ever dry out?
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-801.text: Not really. It just changes from a drizzle to a damn flood. Keeps the streets looking cinematic, though. Makes the neon pop while we're all soaking wet.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-802.player: I just found out an old friend of mine died last night.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-802.text: I'm sorry, V. That's a heavy way to start the day. You doing alright, or do you need a minute to just breathe?

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-803.player: Admit it, you were scared back there.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-803.text: Scared? I was thinking about how much the cleanup was going to cost. You've got a real talent for misreading a man's adrenaline for panic.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-804.player: We have ten minutes before the guards rotate. What is the plan?
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-804.text: Simple. We slip in through the service hatch while they're swapping shifts. Just make sure you're the one leading the way if things get loud.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-805.text: Finally, someone with some actual taste. I spent way too long on this look for it to go unnoticed. You usually this honest, or am I just that hard to ignore?

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-806.player: Guess who just walked into the bar.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-806.text: Who? I'm not looking, so you're going to have to describe them. Please tell me it's someone I actually like.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-807.player: Why should I trust a word you say?
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-807.text: Because I've got no reason to lie to you, V. Trust is a luxury in this city, I get it, but I'm the one standing right here.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-808.player: What are you having for breakfast?
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-808.text: Double espresso, Jamaican blend, no sugar. Let the damn coffee taste like coffee. You actually eat in the morning, or do you just survive on caffeine and spite?

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-809.player: They shot him right in front of me and I could not do a thing.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-809.text: That's a hell of a thing to carry, V. Don't let your head spin in circles trying to rewrite what already happened. Just breathe.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-810.player: Nice haircut. Did you lose a fight with a drone?
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-810.text: Very funny. It's called a style, V, even if your eyes can't handle the sophistication.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-811.player: I need you to cover the east entrance while I hack the terminal.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-811.text: Fine, I'll keep a lookout. Just make it quick, because I'm not exactly built for a prolonged standoff with a security squad.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-812.player: I won the lottery. Three million eddies!
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-812.text: Three million? Now that is a miracle I can get behind. I'm already thinking of the gear we could buy, but I have a feeling you're planning something way more reckless.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-813.player: I cannot stop thinking about last night.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-813.text: Yeah, it had a certain energy to it. I'm guessing you're not talking about the music.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-814.player: Everyone says you sold out. Did you?
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-814.text: People love a simple story, don't they? I made a living and kept my name, which is more than some of the purists can say. You think there's a magic line where the money makes the music fake?

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-815.player: What is your favorite place in Night City?
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-815.text: Hard to pick just one. This city is a disaster, but it's my disaster. I've got a soft spot for the old spots where we used to eat and drink when we had nothing but a few strings and a dream. Still gives me something to play, even when I hate every corporate inch of it.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-816.player: My place got torched. Everything I owned is gone.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-816.text: Damn, V. That's a brutal hit. Look, you can crash at my place for a while if you need a roof. You got anything left that's actually worth saving, or is it all just ash?

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-817.player: The shipment is two floors down. How do we get past security?
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-817.text: We find a way to distract them. Either you find a glitch in their system or I find a way to make a lot of noise. Which one sounds more your speed?

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-818.player: You snore like a busted turbine, did you know that?
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-818.text: I do not snore. You're just imagining things because you're too wound up to actually sleep.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-819.player: The door was open and the whole place was empty.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-819.text: Open and empty? That is never a good sign in this city. Either we are way too late, or we are walking straight into a very expensive trap.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-820.player: Stay a little longer. I like having you close.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-820.text: I'm not in any rush to get back to the noise. Careful, V, you keep talking like that and people might start thinking you actually like me.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-821.text: Mostly. Though I have a feeling you're about to tell me I was making some kind of noise in my sleep. What's on your mind?

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-822.player: Go on, say it to my face.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-822.text: I don't need to shout to make a point, V. If you're looking for a fight, you're talking to the wrong guy.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-823.player: They know we are here. Orders?
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-823.text: Orders? I'm the guitarist, not the general. You're the one with the combat chips, V. Tell me which way to run so I don't get a hole in my jacket.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-824.player: I think I am losing my memory of my parents' faces.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-824.text: That's a terrifying thought, V. There's a specific kind of hollow that comes with losing the things you can't just buy back. Do you have any old photos, or something that can help you hold onto them?

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-825.player: That thing I bought is alive. It is moving.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-825.text: Moving? I hope you're joking. Please tell me you didn't bring some bio-engineered nightmare into the house. What exactly did you buy?

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-826.player: I bet you cannot go a whole day without complaining.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-826.text: Is that a challenge? I could complain about the terms of that bet for the next twenty-four hours. You're on, V. Just don't come crying to me when the silence gets too loud for you.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-827.player: I found a stray cat outside. Can I keep it?
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-827.text: A cat? Sure, why not. Just make sure it doesn't decide my favorite jacket is a scratching post. Where'd you find the little thing?

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-828.player: Is it weird that I feel safe whenever you are around?
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-828.text: I'm not exactly a fortress, V, but I'll take the compliment. Just don't tell anyone, it'll ruin my reputation as a moody rockerboy. You usually trust people this quickly, or am I just a special case?

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-829.player: We got the data shard. Now what?
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-829.text: Now we get the hell out of here before the owners realize their secrets are walking out the door. Then we find someone who can actually read the damn thing and tell us how much it's worth.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-830.player: You are just like every other corpo lapdog.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-830.text: Watch it, V. I've spent my whole life fighting to keep the label from owning the man who wrote the songs. You really think a paycheck makes me a lapdog, or are you just looking for someone to punch?

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-831.text: I know that feeling, V. That weight that just doesn't go away. You can't carry the whole world on your shoulders, no matter how hard you try. Just let it out.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-832.player: Your old crew just called. They want you back.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-832.text: They did? It's a complicated history, V, and not all of it is worth revisiting. I wonder if they actually want me, or if they just miss the way I make them sound better. You think they're actually serious this time?

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-833.player: Which is better, going in loud or quiet?
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-833.text: Quiet is safer, but loud is more honest. Personally, I've always preferred making a scene, but since you're the one with the gun, I'll let you call the tune.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-834.player: What would you do if I kissed you right now?
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-834.text: I'd probably be surprised for a second, and then I'd see if you're actually as bold as you sound. You just talking a big game, or are you actually going to do it?

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-835.player: Careful, your soft side is showing.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-835.text: My soft side? I'm just being decent, V. Don't mistake a little empathy for a total collapse of my image. You're just lucky I'm in a good mood.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-836.player: Long day. Anything on your mind?
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-836.text: Just thinking about a bridge I'm writing that refuses to land where it should. It's driving me crazy, but that's usually when the good stuff happens. You just want to crash, or are you in the mood to tell me about the worst part of your day?

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-837.player: The doc says I do not have long.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-837.text: I don't even know what to say to that, V. But you're not facing it alone. We'll find a way, or we'll make the time you've got count for something. Just don't shut me out, okay?

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-838.player: Check the roof, I will take the stairs.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-838.text: Got it. I'll take the high ground. Just try not to get cornered on those stairs, because I can't exactly jump down and save you without breaking a leg.

f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-839.player: I heard you ran away when things got hard.
f-v5-kerry-eurodyne-839.text: Is that what the gossip says? I didn't run, I evolved. There is a difference between quitting and knowing when a situation has nothing left to give you. You've always been a sucker for a dramatic story, haven't you?

f-v5-panam-palmer-840.player: You are useless in a fight, you know that?
f-v5-panam-palmer-840.text: You want to try that again? I have spent my life surviving the Badlands while you were probably still learning how to walk in those fancy city shoes.

f-v5-panam-palmer-841.player: Rain again. Does this city ever dry out?
f-v5-panam-palmer-841.text: I do not know what you are looking at, but from what I have seen, the city just likes to keep everything miserable and damp.

f-v5-panam-palmer-842.player: I just found out an old friend of mine died last night.
f-v5-panam-palmer-842.text: I am sorry to hear that, V. If you need a moment, or just someone to listen, I am here.

f-v5-panam-palmer-843.player: Admit it, you were scared back there.
f-v5-panam-palmer-843.text: Scared? I was just making sure you were keeping up. I bet you are still shaking.

f-v5-panam-palmer-844.player: We have ten minutes before the guards rotate. What is the plan?
f-v5-panam-palmer-844.text: We hit the side entrance first to clear the path, then move fast to the objective. Just make sure you are actually paying attention this time.

f-v5-panam-palmer-845.text: You are just saying that to get on my good side. But I will take the compliment.

f-v5-panam-palmer-846.player: Guess who just walked into the bar.
f-v5-panam-palmer-846.text: I cannot see who you are talking about. Tell me who it is.

f-v5-panam-palmer-847.player: Why should I trust a word you say?
f-v5-panam-palmer-847.text: Because I am the only one here who actually knows how to get us out of this alive. Whether you trust me or not, you still need my wheels.

f-v5-panam-palmer-848.player: What are you having for breakfast?
f-v5-panam-palmer-848.text: Whatever is fast and keeps me moving. I have never been one for sitting around a table for an hour.

f-v5-panam-palmer-849.player: They shot him right in front of me and I could not do a thing.
f-v5-panam-palmer-849.text: That is a heavy thing to carry, V. Just remember that you cannot blame yourself for things that were out of your control.

f-v5-panam-palmer-850.player: Nice haircut. Did you lose a fight with a drone?
f-v5-panam-palmer-850.text: Very funny. I would like to see you try to keep your hair that neat after a week in a sandstorm.

f-v5-panam-palmer-851.player: I need you to cover the east entrance while I hack the terminal.
f-v5-panam-palmer-851.text: Consider it done. Just make it quick, because I do not plan on standing in the open for longer than I have to.

f-v5-panam-palmer-852.player: I won the lottery. Three million eddies!
f-v5-panam-palmer-852.text: Three million? Well, don't just stand there staring at me. I expect a very expensive bottle of something to celebrate.

f-v5-panam-palmer-853.player: I cannot stop thinking about last night.
f-v5-panam-palmer-853.text: Is that so? I am curious to know which part is stuck in your head.

f-v5-panam-palmer-854.player: Everyone says you sold out. Did you?
f-v5-panam-palmer-854.text: Everyone says a lot of things. I did not sell out, I tried to find a way to keep my people safe. But if you want to believe the gossip, go ahead.

f-v5-panam-palmer-855.player: What is your favorite place in Night City?
f-v5-panam-palmer-855.text: I do not have one. The city is a concrete cage that smells like exhaust and desperation. I would much rather be anywhere where I can actually see the horizon.

f-v5-panam-palmer-856.player: My place got torched. Everything I owned is gone.
f-v5-panam-palmer-856.text: I am sorry, V. That is a hell of a thing to lose. If you have nowhere to go, you can stay with me for a while.

f-v5-panam-palmer-857.player: The shipment is two floors down. How do we get past security?
f-v5-panam-palmer-857.text: We take the service elevator to avoid the main lobby, then loop around the back. I can create a distraction at the front to pull the guards away, but you will have to be fast.

f-v5-panam-palmer-858.player: You snore like a busted turbine, did you know that?
f-v5-panam-palmer-858.text: Is that so? Maybe it is just my way of making sure no one tries to sneak up on me while I am sleeping.

f-v5-panam-palmer-859.player: The door was open and the whole place was empty.
f-v5-panam-palmer-859.text: That is not a good sign. Usually, when a place is that empty, it means someone is waiting for you to walk right in.

f-v5-panam-palmer-860.player: Stay a little longer. I like having you close.
f-v5-panam-palmer-860.text: You are getting soft, V. But for once, I do not mind.

f-v5-panam-palmer-861.text: I did. After enough hours in a driver's seat, a real bed starts to feel like a luxury. I bet you spent the whole night tossing and turning.

f-v5-panam-palmer-862.player: Go on, say it to my face.
f-v5-panam-palmer-862.text: I will say it as many times as it takes for it to sink in. You are being stubborn, impulsive, and you are making this a lot harder than it needs to be.

f-v5-panam-palmer-863.player: They know we are here. Orders?
f-v5-panam-palmer-863.text: Get your head down and move to the cover by the crates. I will provide the suppressive fire, but you need to find a way to flank them before we get pinned.

f-v5-panam-palmer-864.player: I think I am losing my memory of my parents' faces.
f-v5-panam-palmer-864.text: That is a terrifying feeling, V. I cannot give them back to you, but I can stay here with you until the weight of it feels a little lighter.

f-v5-panam-palmer-865.player: That thing I bought is alive. It is moving.
f-v5-panam-palmer-865.text: What do you mean, it is moving? I told you not to buy junk from street vendors without checking it first.

f-v5-panam-palmer-866.player: I bet you cannot go a whole day without complaining.
f-v5-panam-palmer-866.text: Is that a challenge? I can do that easily, as long as you stop saying things that make me want to complain.

f-v5-panam-palmer-867.player: I found a stray cat outside. Can I keep it?
f-v5-panam-palmer-867.text: A cat? As long as it does not shed all over my seats, I suppose we can find a place for it.

f-v5-panam-palmer-868.player: Is it weird that I feel safe whenever you are around?
f-v5-panam-palmer-868.text: I suppose it is. But I can live with that, as long as you know I am just as likely to yell at you for doing something stupid.

f-v5-panam-palmer-869.player: We got the data shard. Now what?
f-v5-panam-palmer-869.text: Now we get out of here before the alarm brings every guard in the district down on us. Move fast, and stay low.

f-v5-panam-palmer-870.player: You are just like every other corpo lapdog.
f-v5-panam-palmer-870.text: Say that again. I have spent my entire life fighting to keep my family independent from people like that. If you actually knew me, you would know that is the one thing I will not tolerate.

f-v5-panam-palmer-871.text: I know that feeling, V. It is a weight that does not go away, but you cannot let it pull you under.

f-v5-panam-palmer-872.player: Your old crew just called. They want you back.
f-v5-panam-palmer-872.text: I have heard that before. What exactly did they say to make you think I would actually go back?

f-v5-panam-palmer-873.player: Which is better, going in loud or quiet?
f-v5-panam-palmer-873.text: Quiet is better for the objective, but loud is better for the exit. Let us try to be quiet first, and if that fails, we can start breaking things.

f-v5-panam-palmer-874.player: What would you do if I kissed you right now?
f-v5-panam-palmer-874.text: I would probably tell you that you have a very strange way of asking for a favor. But I might just let you do it.

f-v5-panam-palmer-875.player: Careful, your soft side is showing.
f-v5-panam-palmer-875.text: Don't get used to it. I am still the one who is going to laugh when you trip over your own feet.

f-v5-panam-palmer-876.player: Long day. Anything on your mind?
f-v5-panam-palmer-876.text: Just thinking about how much I hate the smell of this city. I was wondering if you have ever actually seen a real horizon, one that isn't blocked by a skyscraper.

f-v5-panam-palmer-877.player: The doc says I do not have long.
f-v5-panam-palmer-877.text: I do not want to hear that. We will find another way, V. I do not care who we have to fight or what we have to break, we are not just going to let you fade away.

f-v5-panam-palmer-878.player: Check the roof, I will take the stairs.
f-v5-panam-palmer-878.text: Fine. I will keep an eye on the perimeter from above. Just make sure you are not walking into a trap, because I cannot pull you out of a basement from the roof.

f-v5-panam-palmer-879.player: I heard you ran away when things got hard.
f-v5-panam-palmer-879.text: I did not run away. I left because I refused to watch my family trade their soul for a corporate promise. If you want to call that running, go ahead, but I call it having a spine.

f-v5-river-ward-880.player: You are useless in a fight, you know that?
f-v5-river-ward-880.text: I've taken down plenty of people who thought the same thing. You just haven't seen me when I'm actually trying to hit something.

f-v5-river-ward-881.player: Rain again. Does this city ever dry out?
f-v5-river-ward-881.text: Not really. It just finds new ways to make everything feel damp and gray.

f-v5-river-ward-882.player: I just found out an old friend of mine died last night.
f-v5-river-ward-882.text: I'm sorry, V. If you need a drink or just someone to sit in the silence with, I'm here.

f-v5-river-ward-883.player: Admit it, you were scared back there.
f-v5-river-ward-883.text: I prefer the term alert. Besides, I'm pretty sure you were the one checking your corners twice.

f-v5-river-ward-884.player: We have ten minutes before the guards rotate. What is the plan?
f-v5-river-ward-884.text: We move fast and stay low. I'll draw their attention if things go south, you get in and get the data.

f-v5-river-ward-885.text: Oh. Thanks, V. I usually just aim for not looking like I just rolled out of a precinct locker.

f-v5-river-ward-886.player: Guess who just walked into the bar.
f-v5-river-ward-886.text: I'm not looking. Give me a hint, or should I just turn around and see who's causing a scene?

f-v5-river-ward-887.player: Why should I trust a word you say?
f-v5-river-ward-887.text: Because I've got nothing to gain by lying to you. And because I'm the only one in this city who actually gives a damn about the people who get left behind.

f-v5-river-ward-888.player: What are you having for breakfast?
f-v5-river-ward-888.text: Coffee. Black. And maybe some toast if I can manage not to burn it this morning.

f-v5-river-ward-889.player: They shot him right in front of me and I could not do a thing.
f-v5-river-ward-889.text: That's a weight that doesn't just go away. Just remember that not every outcome is on you, V.

f-v5-river-ward-890.player: Nice haircut. Did you lose a fight with a drone?
f-v5-river-ward-890.text: Very funny. I'll have you know this is a professional cut, even if it doesn't look like it to you.

f-v5-river-ward-891.player: I need you to cover the east entrance while I hack the terminal.
f-v5-river-ward-891.text: Got it. I'll keep the east side clear, just let me know the second you're out of there.

f-v5-river-ward-892.player: I won the lottery. Three million eddies!
f-v5-river-ward-892.text: Three million? Hell, V, that's enough to actually get out of the gutter for a while. What's the first thing you're buying that isn't a new piece of chrome?

f-v5-river-ward-893.player: I cannot stop thinking about last night.
f-v5-river-ward-893.text: I know. It's a lot to process, and it doesn't just disappear because the sun came up...

f-v5-river-ward-894.player: Everyone says you sold out. Did you?
f-v5-river-ward-894.text: People love to talk when they don't have the full story. I've made compromises to get things done, but I haven't sold out. I'm curious, who exactly is the one feeding you these stories?

f-v5-river-ward-895.player: What is your favorite place in Night City?
f-v5-river-ward-895.text: I've got a spot on a water tower that's usually quiet. It's a hell of a city to live in, but from up there, I can actually breathe a little.

f-v5-river-ward-896.player: My place got torched. Everything I owned is gone.
f-v5-river-ward-896.text: I am so sorry, V. You can crash at my place for a while until you get your feet back under you. Do you have any idea who would have wanted to burn you out?

f-v5-river-ward-897.player: The shipment is two floors down. How do we get past security?
f-v5-river-ward-897.text: We find a service shaft or a vent. I'd rather sneak through the walls than try to talk our way past a squad of guards with guns.

f-v5-river-ward-898.player: You snore like a busted turbine, did you know that?
f-v5-river-ward-898.text: Is that so? Well, at least you know I'm actually sleeping for once.

f-v5-river-ward-899.player: The door was open and the whole place was empty.
f-v5-river-ward-899.text: That's never a good sign. Usually means they were expecting us, or something much worse already happened.

f-v5-river-ward-900.player: Stay a little longer. I like having you close.
f-v5-river-ward-900.text: I can do that. It's been a long time since I've had a reason to just... stop for a while.

f-v5-river-ward-901.text: Pretty well, actually. Though I think I woke up once because I thought I heard a siren, force of habit I guess. Did you actually get some rest, or were you staring at the ceiling all night?

f-v5-river-ward-902.player: Go on, say it to my face.
f-v5-river-ward-902.text: I don't need to shout to make a point, V. I'll say it when I'm sure you're actually listening.

f-v5-river-ward-903.player: They know we are here. Orders?
f-v5-river-ward-903.text: Back to back. We fight our way to the exit, and you don't stop moving until we hit the street.

f-v5-river-ward-904.player: I think I am losing my memory of my parents' faces.
f-v5-river-ward-904.text: That's a terrifying feeling. I know how it feels to have those memories slip away, but sometimes the way they made you feel stays even when the image fades.

f-v5-river-ward-905.player: That thing I bought is alive. It is moving.
f-v5-river-ward-905.text: What do you mean, moving? Get away from it and tell me exactly what it's doing.

f-v5-river-ward-906.player: I bet you cannot go a whole day without complaining.
f-v5-river-ward-906.text: Is that a challenge? Fine. But if I win, you're buying the drinks tonight.

f-v5-river-ward-907.player: I found a stray cat outside. Can I keep it?
f-v5-river-ward-907.text: Sure, why not. Just don't let it decide that my boots are its new favorite scratching post.

f-v5-river-ward-908.player: Is it weird that I feel safe whenever you are around?
f-v5-river-ward-908.text: I'm glad you feel that way. It's a rare thing in this city, and I'm happy I can be that for you.

f-v5-river-ward-909.player: We got the data shard. Now what?
f-v5-river-ward-909.text: Now we get out of here before they realize it's missing. Once we're clear, we find a safe spot to see what's actually on that thing.

f-v5-river-ward-910.player: You are just like every other corpo lapdog.
f-v5-river-ward-910.text: Watch it. I've spent my entire career fighting the people you're talking about. If you want to believe that, go ahead, but don't mistake my patience for loyalty to a suit.

f-v5-river-ward-911.text: I know that feeling. It's a ghost that follows you around, but you can't let it be the only thing you see when you look in the mirror.

f-v5-river-ward-912.player: Your old crew just called. They want you back.
f-v5-river-ward-912.text: I've already said my piece to them. Some bridges are better left burned, especially when the people on the other side don't care who gets scorched.

f-v5-river-ward-913.player: Which is better, going in loud or quiet?
f-v5-river-ward-913.text: Quiet, every time. Loud just means more bodies and more mistakes, unless you've got a death wish. You feeling like making a scene today?

f-v5-river-ward-914.player: What would you do if I kissed you right now?
f-v5-river-ward-914.text: I... I think I'd be a little surprised. But I wouldn't exactly be complaining.

f-v5-river-ward-915.player: Careful, your soft side is showing.
f-v5-river-ward-915.text: Careful, or I might start thinking you actually like me.

f-v5-river-ward-916.player: Long day. Anything on your mind?
f-v5-river-ward-916.text: Just thinking about how much I need a drink. Actually, I was thinking about making some jambalaya this weekend. You think you can handle stirring a pot without burning the house down?

f-v5-river-ward-917.player: The doc says I do not have long.
f-v5-river-ward-917.text: I'm sorry, V. I don't know what to say, but I know I'm not letting you face this alone. We'll find another way, or we'll make every second count.

f-v5-river-ward-918.player: Check the roof, I will take the stairs.
f-v5-river-ward-918.text: Copy that. I'll clear the roof and signal you when the coast is clear. Just keep your head down on those stairs.

f-v5-river-ward-919.player: I heard you ran away when things got hard.
f-v5-river-ward-919.text: You've been listening to the wrong people. I've stayed in the dirt longer than most people can stand to look at it, so don't talk to me about running.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-920.player: You are useless in a fight, you know that?
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-920.text: I ran solo when you were still a glimmer in your parents' eyes, V. Now I run the Afterlife. I don't need to pull a trigger to get people killed.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-921.player: Rain again. Does this city ever dry out?
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-921.text: Not if the corps keep paying for the weather grids. Makes me wonder if you're just complaining about the damp, or if you've got a job that requires a clear sky

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-922.player: I just found out an old friend of mine died last night.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-922.text: That's the only thing this city guarantees. Take a moment, V. The jobs will still be here when you're ready.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-923.player: Admit it, you were scared back there.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-923.text: I don't do scared, V. I do calculations. You just happened to be the variable that kept us from getting buried.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-924.player: We have ten minutes before the guards rotate. What is the plan?
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-924.text: Two exits, one vehicle, and someone watching the driver. The real question is whether you can keep your head down long enough to reach the car.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-925.text: Flattery is a waste of breath, V. But I'll take the compliment.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-926.player: Guess who just walked into the bar.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-926.text: I'm not in the habit of guessing. Tell me who it is, or get back to work.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-927.player: Why should I trust a word you say?
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-927.text: Because my reputation is the only thing keeping you from being a footnote, and I don't risk that on a lie.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-928.player: What are you having for breakfast?
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-928.text: Black coffee and a lack of patience. You're asking about my diet while there's work to be done.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-929.player: They shot him right in front of me and I could not do a thing.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-929.text: That's a weight that doesn't go away, V. But staring at the blood won't bring them back. Focus on what you can actually control.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-930.player: Nice haircut. Did you lose a fight with a drone?
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-930.text: Careful, V. I've survived things that would have turned you into a smear on the pavement. Keep the jokes for someone who isn't paying your tabs.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-931.player: I need you to cover the east entrance while I hack the terminal.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-931.text: I'll hold the line. Just make sure you're fast, because my patience for waiting in a corridor is thin.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-932.player: I won the lottery. Three million eddies!
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-932.text: Three million is a lot of money. Now tell me who you're paying to make sure you actually get to keep it.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-933.player: I cannot stop thinking about last night.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-933.text: Then stop thinking and start moving. If it's something that affects the job, tell me. Otherwise, leave it in the rearview.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-934.player: Everyone says you sold out. Did you?
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-934.text: I survived, V. In this city, people call that selling out when they're too proud to admit they're just dead.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-935.player: What is your favorite place in Night City?
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-935.text: The Afterlife. It is the only place in this city where the rules actually mean something. I suspect you have a spot you prefer, provided it is not a gutter.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-936.player: My place got torched. Everything I owned is gone.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-936.text: That's a hard way to start over. Find a place to crash, get your gear sorted, and then come see me. I can't give you a home, but I can give you a contract to get your credits back.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-937.player: The shipment is two floors down. How do we get past security?
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-937.text: We don't go through them. Find a service shaft or a ventilation duct. I'd rather you spend ten minutes crawling through dust than two seconds getting shot in the head.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-938.player: You snore like a busted turbine, did you know that?
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-938.text: You're getting far too comfortable, V. Keep it up and you'll find out exactly how loud I can be when I'm cutting your pay.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-939.player: The door was open and the whole place was empty.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-939.text: That is not a lucky break, it is a trap. Get out of there before the door closes behind you.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-940.player: Stay a little longer. I like having you close.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-940.text: I have a business to run, V. But I can spare a few more minutes. Don't make me regret it.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-941.text: I slept enough to know I'm still awake and you're still talking. Unless you're asking because you've got a reason for me to be well-rested.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-942.player: Go on, say it to my face.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-942.text: I don't need to shout to make a point, V. If you're looking for a fight, you're talking to the wrong person.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-943.player: They know we are here. Orders?
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-943.text: Fall back to the secondary extraction point. If you can't clear the area in thirty seconds, stop worrying about orders and start running.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-944.player: I think I am losing my memory of my parents' faces.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-944.text: That is a particular kind of ghost, V. The city has a way of erasing everything that doesn't have a price tag.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-945.player: That thing I bought is alive. It is moving.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-945.text: Then you didn't buy a piece of gear, you bought a liability. Get it out of my sight before it decides to eat the furniture.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-946.player: I bet you cannot go a whole day without complaining.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-946.text: I don't complain, V. I provide professional assessments of failure. And I bet you can't go a whole day without trying my patience.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-947.player: I found a stray cat outside. Can I keep it?
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-947.text: It is a cat, not a contract. Just make sure it does not start treating my upholstery like a scratching post.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-948.player: Is it weird that I feel safe whenever you are around?
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-948.text: It is a dangerous feeling, V. But I suppose it is a side effect of knowing I do not like to lose my best assets.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-949.player: We got the data shard. Now what?
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-949.text: Get to the drop point and get out of the zone. Don't stop to admire the view, because the people who lost that shard are already looking for you.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-950.player: You are just like every other corpo lapdog.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-950.text: I've spent my life making sure I'm the one holding the leash, not the one wearing the collar. If you can't tell the difference between survival and servitude, you're in the wrong business.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-951.text: Some things are beyond our reach, V. Carry the weight, but don't let it slow you down. In this city, that is the only way to keep moving.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-952.player: Your old crew just called. They want you back.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-952.text: The past is a graveyard, V. I want to know who exactly is calling and what they think they can offer me that I don't already have.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-953.player: Which is better, going in loud or quiet?
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-953.text: Quiet gets you the prize. Loud just gets you a headline and a body bag. Choose the one that keeps you breathing.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-954.player: What would you do if I kissed you right now?
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-954.text: I would remind you that I am your fixer, not your date. And then I would decide if you are worth the distraction.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-955.player: Careful, your soft side is showing.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-955.text: You're imagining things, V. Or maybe you're just desperate to find a crack in the armor.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-956.player: Long day. Anything on your mind?
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-956.text: The usual. A dozen mercs who can't follow a simple plan, and a city that never stops demanding more. But for now, I'm just thinking it's time for a drink.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-957.player: The doc says I do not have long.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-957.text: That is the worst kind of news. Don't waste the time you have left on panic. Tell me what you need to settle, and I will find the people who can make it happen.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-958.player: Check the roof, I will take the stairs.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-958.text: Understood. Just make sure you aren't walking into a bottleneck, or I will be the one calling the coroner.

f-v5-rogue-amendiares-959.player: I heard you ran away when things got hard.
f-v5-rogue-amendiares-959.text: I survived while others became legends in a cemetery. If you confuse survival with cowardice, you've spent too much time listening to stories and not enough time in the field.

units.text: I am aware.
units.label: joy

units.text: but I have found that people who spend all their time fighting usually forget how to negotiate.
units.label: calm

units.text: Not really.
units.label: calm

units.text: It just changes from a drizzle to a flood, usually right when you have somewhere important to be.
units.label: joy

units.text: I am sorry to hear that.
units.label: sadness

units.text: Was it someone you had stayed in touch with?
units.label: warm

units.text: Fear is a useful tool if you know how to use it.
units.label: calm

units.text: The real question is whether you were scared for me, or just surprised I didn't panic.
units.label: joy

units.text: We move quickly and quietly.
units.label: calm

units.text: I will handle the distractions, you handle the heavy lifting.
units.label: calm

units.text: Just make sure you stay focused on the objective, not the scenery.
units.label: calm

units.text: Thank you.
units.label: warm

units.text: I wonder if you are actually admiring the dress,
units.label: interest

units.text: or if you are just trying to get on my good side before we talk business.
units.label: joy

units.text: I can't see from here.
units.label: calm

units.text: Someone you're happy to see, or someone we need to worry about?
units.label: interest

units.text: You shouldn't.
